source_metadata.question: In the triangle $P Q R$, the lengths of sides $P Q$ and $P R$ are the same. The point $S$ lies on $Q R$ so that $Q S=P S$ and $\angle R P S=75^{\circ}$. What is the size of $\angle Q R P$ ? <image1>
source_metadata.subject: metric geometry - angle

source_metadata.question: The diagram shows three triangles which are formed by the five line segments $A C D F, B C G, G D E, A B$ and $E F$ so that $A C=B C=C D=G D=D F=E F$. Also $\angle C A B=\angle E F D$. What is the size, in degrees, of $\angle C A B$ ? <image1>
